subject: High error spikes and tail-latency — proposed financial reconciliation and exec alignment
messages:
From: prodops@heliosanalytics.com
To: rohan.mehta@redwood.com
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 10 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Intermittent 5xx spike + sustained tail-latency — urgent

Hi Rohan,

We saw a ~3 hour window of elevated 5xx rates and tail-latency spikes this morning across two of our high-throughput routes. Error rate peaked around 6% and p95 tail-latency jumped from ~220ms to >1.6s for multi-turn chat sessions — impacting several customers. Throughput dropped as clients retried, so effective tokens/sec dropped ~28%.

We attached a short log sample and a histogram of client-side retries. Can Redwood confirm root cause and provide immediate mitigation steps? Our execs are asking for a commercial remediation estimate; they specifically called out our SLA credit clause and want numbers ASAP.

We can do an emergency call if helpful — Sarah (cc) is available for a 30-min sync this afternoon PST.

Attachments: request-log-sample.json (snippet), helm_histogram.png (referenced)

Thanks,
--
Helios ProdOps
prodops@heliosanalytics.com

From: rohan.mehta@redwood.com
To: prodops@heliosanalytics.com
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwood.com, sean.gallagher@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 11:23:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intermittent 5xx spike + sustained tail-latency — urgent

Hi — thanks for the detailed sample and flagging this. I’ve opened an incident (INC-20260110-HEL-1) with infra and service reliability teams and we’re prioritizing this. Preliminary notes:

- Immediate: rolling a targeted config that pins the model shard routing to reduce cross-host cache misses (will push within 30–45 mins).
- Short-term: enable conservative batching thresholds and disable an experimental kernel path we rolled last week (reduces tail variance).
- We're preserving traces and will share an RCA draft within 48 hours.

We understand the commercial exposure; Neha, can you advise on the current commercial ask from Helios? Sean — I’ve looped you for customer success continuity. Laura, FYI — given exec interest, we may need a leadership sync to align on credits.

I’ve attached the mitigation playbook and a 1‑page runbook for the immediate pin. Will follow up after the config rollout.

Best,
Rohan
Staff SRE, Redwood Inference
rohan.mehta@redwood.com
Attachment: mitigation_playbook.pdf
From: neha.kapoor@redwood.com
To: rohan.mehta@redwood.com, sean.gallagher@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 14:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intermittent 5xx spike + sustained tail-latency — urgent

Thanks Rohan — quick commercial note from Helios: Sarah and Legal said they will request a reconciliation covering the incident window plus a conservative buffer (total 4 hours) and asked for the SLA credit math per our contract (section 4.2). They suggested a capped credit or one-time invoice rebate; customer prefers a monetary credit over service-extension.

Can we quickly model: 1) pro-rated credit for affected requests, and 2) a goodwill concession (flat $X) to close at exec level? I don’t have pricing for that account handy — putting a placeholder in the attached CSV for your inputs.

We should get Laura on the call with Helios execs if we recommend >5% ARR credit equivalent.

Neha
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Attachment: credit_calc_v1.csv
From: laura.bennett@redwood.com
To: neha.kapoor@redwood.com, rohan.mehta@redwood.com, sean.gallagher@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 13 Jan 2026 09:35:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: Draft commercial remediation recommendation

Quick internal note (do not forward):

I reviewed Helios usage and the bill run for Dec — monthly spend is ~$72k. If we follow the contract SLA schedule (4 hours incident window + buffer), early back-of-envelope shows a pro-rated credit in the range of 4–6% of monthly bill (~$3k–$4.5k). Given the exec escalation, my recommendation:

- Offer the calculated pro-rated credit per contract.
- Add a one-time $5k goodwill concession (conditional on signing the attached two-way remediation addendum).
- Commit to a technical action plan with defined SLO targets and a 90-day check-in.

If that sounds reasonable we can present to Helios, with Neha leading commercial and me on exec call. Sean, please prep a short CS remediation timeline so we can show concrete next steps. Rohan, we’ll need the final RCA and a written mitigation timeline within 72 hours.

Laura Bennett
Director, Sales — Enterprise Accounts
Attachment: (internal) credit_calc_v1_filled.csv
From: rohan.mehta@redwood.com
To: prodops@heliosanalytics.com, sarah.lang@heliosanalytics.com
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com, sean.gallagher@redwood.com, contracts@heliosanalytics.com
Date: Wed, 14 Jan 2026 17:55:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intermittent 5xx spike + sustained tail-latency — urgent

Sarah / Helios team — thanks for working with us on this. Summary and next steps: 

1) Commercial: per our review, Redwood will issue a pro-rated credit equivalent to 4.5% of January’s invoice for the affected routes (covers the 4-hour window + buffer). In addition, we offer a one-time $5,000 goodwill concession. Neha will coordinate the accounting entries and apply the credit to your next invoice (ref DEAL-8893).

2) Technical remediation: we rolled the targeted config and disabled the experimental kernel during the incident window — these changes reduced p95 to ~230ms in our staging replay. Rohan (me) will deliver the RCA and mitigation timeline within 48 hours.

3) Exec alignment: Laura and Neha will join a 30-min executive-level call on Thu 15 Jan at 10:00 AM PST to sign off on the remediation addendum. We will prepare a DocuSign for the two-way addendum and share the link prior to the call: https://docusign.example.com/r/ABC12345.

4) Conditions: The commercial offer is conditioned on Helios executing the remediation addendum within 10 business days. If Helios prefers a different reconciliation approach, let us know before the call.

Please confirm the time or propose alternatives.

Best,
Rohan Mehta
Staff SRE, Redwood Inference
rohan.mehta@redwood.com
